output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The approveProxy function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before approving tokens. This could allow a user to approve more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The allocateTokens function does not check if the total supply and balances will overflow before allocating tokens. This could allow a user to allocate more tokens than the contract can hold, potentially leading to loss of funds.
